reason: I don't know these partners and there are no reviews yet, so I can't tell a good installer from a bad one. Escrow and the written warranty are nice, but I still wouldn't hand over about SAR 1,500 for paint film on the M4 to a company I've never heard of.
objection: Nobody I know has used this, and I can't see what real customers say about the installers.
would_change_my_mind: A few verified reviews from car owners in Riyadh or Cairo who had the same job done, or a recommendation from someone in my family group.
